Faces with their own anatomy: draft

Each pair is the same person: today's face on the left, the new face on the right, at 104px and 48px, plus the new face at 32px. Hair, skin, chrome, light and gear are untouched; only the face itself changes. Eye spacing, size, tilt and lid (monolid, crease, hooded, deep-set), brow weight and arch, nose length, width and bridge, mouth width and lips, jaw, chin, ears and neck all vary, from a third seed, so the face is still fixed per person.

Shaolin warrior monks

A new kind of monk, in the game now on today's faces: saffron robe with a dark crossed collar, a heavy mala of big dark beads, and nine ordination dots on the shaved crown. Bare-faced (no mask, hat or glasses). About 4% of Hong Kong names and 3% of Southeast Asian ones; anyone else rarely. A new pick at the end of the gear seed, so nobody else's look changed.
